source: Pew Research Center (Pew Hispanic Center and Pew Forum on Religion & Public Life). "Changing Faiths: Latinos and the Transformation of American Religion," survey of 4,016 U.S. Hispanic adults, fielded Aug. 10-Oct. 4, 2006.
method: Population is Hispanic adults currently belonging to each religious group (the survey's own recoded 'relig' variable). Share answering "Yes, volunteered" (vs. "No, did not volunteer") to qn51_a, "In the past year have you volunteered your time to any church or religious group"; don't know/refused excluded from each row's denominator. Groups under 30 valid respondents omitted. Weighted by the dataset's own newweight variable, which corrects for a deliberate oversample of 2,000 non-Catholic respondents.
